tenderSchedule.title: Overhauling, testing and commissioning of 2MVA auxiliary transformers (2 Numbers) at ODY of Nagjhari Power House Ambikanagar
tenderSchedule.description: Two Numbers of Auxiliary transformers need to hauled from the service bay to workshop floor after making necessary disconnections of the existing connections at the service bay, disassembling, inspection, repair of minor faults, transformer interior exterior painting, pre and post repair tests and commissioning tests of 2 MVA unit auxiliary power transformers at Nagjhari Power House, Ambikanagar as per the instructions of KPCL engineer.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer ODY Office KVP Nagjhari

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have experience in repair, overhauling, testing and Commissioning of 3 phase 2 MVA, 11KV/415V and above rating power transformer in any power plant/Industry. In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work/ purchase order of value not less than Rs 10.88 Lakhs (Ten Lakhs Eighty Eight Thousand) during the last five years and corresponding satisfactory performance issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2025-26).

The bidder should have experience in repair, overhauling, testing and Commissioning of 3 phase 2 MVA, 11KV/415V and above rating power transformer in any power plant/Industry. In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work/ purchase order of value not less than Rs 10.88 Lakhs (Ten Lakhs Eighty Eight Thousand) during the last five years and corresponding satisfactory performance issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2025-26).

The bidder should have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs.21.5 Lakhs in any two financial years out of the last five preceding financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The bidders should furnish annual turnover certificates duly signed by Chartered Accountant. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Those bidders whose contracts have been terminated/fore-closed by KPCL or whose performance has not been satisfactory while executing the contract of the above within last five years are not eligible to participate in the bid. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking in this regard (Annexure-A).
